description: This file defines the ClassSingleSegmentBuffer class which implements the IBufferWriter<byte> interface. It provides functionality for buffering bytes within a fixed byte array, allowing advances, retrieval of memory spans, conversion to array, resetting, and getting a read-only sequence.

classes.name: ClassSingleSegmentBuffer
classes.description: A buffer writer implementation that manages a single segment byte buffer, providing methods to write, access, and reset the buffer.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current write position in the buffer by the specified number of bytes.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> spanning the buffer from the current write position, optionally with a size hint.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> spanning the buffer from the current write position, requiring a size hint.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Converts the written portion of the buffer into a byte array.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer's write position to zero, effectively clearing its contents.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to the buffer.

methods.name: GetReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> representing the written data.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the written data in the buffer to a UTF8 string.
